title: Electronic Spices 84mm x61mm 6V 100mAh Rectangle Shaped Polycrystalline Mini Epoxy Solar Panels (Pack of 1)
description: Electronic Spices 84mm x61mm 6V 100mAh Rectangle Shaped Polycrystalline Mini Epoxy Solar Panels (Pack of 1) - Distributed/Packaged by Electronic Spices. Product Details: The 84mm x 61mm 6V 100mAh Mini Polycrystalline Solar Panel is a compact, durable, and efficient power solution for small electronics and educational projects. Designed with a polycrystalline silicon surface and protected by a high-quality epoxy coating, this panel delivers up to 6 volts at 100mAh under optimal sunlight conditions. It’s perfect for DIY hobby kits, STEM education modules, solar-powered toys, wireless sensors, and Arduino-based systems. The rectangle shape and slim profile allow easy integration into small devices and prototypes. The back terminals or solder pads make wiring simple for both beginners and advanced users. This eco-friendly mini solar panel is ideal for experimenting with solar energy conversion, battery charging, and off-grid power setups. Whether you're powering a small fan, charging capacitors, or running microcontrollers, it offers reliable and clean solar energy.
